status: CLOSED 2026-08-13 from the PRIMARY SOURCE with independent verification. Supersedes both the r3 placeholders and the second reviewer pass's claim that the values were ~2x too large.
source: papers/hemingway2019enceladus.pdf Table 1, Tajeddine et al. (2017) block, column sigma_lm^topo*; R_ref = 252.22 km; rho_shell = 925 kg/m^3. Libration model sigma from section 2.6 / Eq. 26.

verification_eq24.check: Against the IESS gravity sigmas H&M used (35.4 / 15.8 / 23.4 e-6) this reproduces Table 1's printed COMBINED column (35.8 / 15.9 / 23.8 e-6) as 35.79 / 15.89 / 23.81 e-6 — three-digit agreement on all three rows, confirming the whole chain is read correctly.

discrepancy_recorded_not_reconciled: Eq. 25 gives 1.780e-6 for (2,2) while Table 1 prints 1.7e-6 — 4.7%, larger than the other rows' agreement and in the direction of truncation rather than rounding. The published 1.7e-6 is adopted as the value of record; the difference is 0.08e-6 = 0.005 sigma_obs, immaterial.
retraction_of_the_second_pass_claim: The second reviewer pass independently propagated sigma_topo and obtained 2.59 / 0.95 / 2.28e-6, concluding the config values were 1.8-2.05x inflated and REOPENING B15. That propagation was wrong: Eq. 25 with H&M's own rho_bar and the (2l+1) factor reproduces the published values to better than 1% on two of three rows, and the Eq. 24 combined-sigma cross-check independently confirms the chain. The r3 NUMBERS were right; only the r3 provenance SENTENCE was defective (it described the combined Iess-era observational sigmas as if they were the model column). Both are now fixed.

effect_on_this_campaign.note: This campaign conditions on PARK 2024 gravity sigmas, not the Iess sigmas H&M used, so the combined sigmas differ from Table 1's.
effect_on_this_campaign.reading: Sigma_model inflates the effective sigmas by under 1.1% on every gravity row and 0.35% on the libration — negligible against the measurement errors. This vindicates H&M's own remark that Tajeddine's shape uncertainties are small enough not to kill the channel, whereas Nimmo's would inflate sigma(C20) ~7x. The libration term must be applied because the SAME H_obs feeds both the gravity rows and the libration row, so their model errors are correlated.
